scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Frilldora?
scripts.translation:
[莱姆利]
你打完50只伞蜥了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[莱姆利]
嗯，我觉得你还没打够50只...

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Remember, I need help hunting Frilldora so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆利]
记住，我需要帮忙打伞蜥，所以去打50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[莱姆利]
你确定要停止狩猎吗？
你目前的进度将会被清除

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆利]
好吧，如果你改变主意了，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Please kill 50 Frilldora.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆利]
请击杀50只伞蜥。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆利]
太棒了，你的速度真快。

The lizards around here have a natural stealth, a property that the Assassin's Guild wants to study.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆利]
这里的蜥蜴天生具有隐身能力，刺客公会想要研究这种特性。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Hey, thank you.
These are pretty icky though.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆利]
嘿，谢谢。
不过这些看起来真恶心。

scripts.text:
[Lemly]
Sigh,
Please, don't waste my time.
scripts.translation:
[莱姆利]
唉，
拜托，别浪费我的时间。

Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Frilldora.
How many would you like to hunt?
